utterances.source_text: the players needing to do shifts in momentum and make this even better.
utterances.translated_text: 选手们需要把握势头转换，让比赛更精彩。

utterances.source_text: Some days it's to an action and then we have, as you mentioned, many actions that we break the position in place. A lot of situations where the next advantage is to go with so much space around and we give the world away. It turns out to be the counter attack. These are the moments that shift momentum and save the world.
utterances.translated_text: 有时是某个动作，然后就会出现——正如你提到的——许多需要就地破解防守的动作。很多情况下，明明有充足空间可以扩大优势，我们却拱手让出球权，结果反而给了对方反击机会。这些正是扭转局势、拯救比赛的关键时刻。

utterances.source_text: the emotional state of the game as well.
utterances.translated_text: 以及比赛中的情绪状态。

utterances.source_text: and just in depth and um
utterances.translated_text: 而且深入来说，呃...

utterances.source_text: I don't know what I'm saying.
utterances.translated_text: 我都不知道自己在说什么。

utterances.source_text: is this one.
utterances.translated_text: 是这个吗？

utterances.source_text: Well, we've played a lot of games and that's part of the issue. But we're going to try to do everything we possibly can to do the best we can.
utterances.translated_text: 我们打了太多比赛，这确实是问题的一部分。但我们会竭尽全力做到最好。

utterances.source_text: I don't know if you can see this.
utterances.translated_text: 不知道你们能否看清这个。

utterances.source_text: Everyone in this room knows why you don't want to give too much away on the 10-match front and obviously that generally is how you like to answer those questions. But the sense I get from supporters is there's a bit of frustration that they've got into the ground.
utterances.translated_text: 在场各位都明白，为何你不愿过多透露十场比赛的情况——这显然是你惯用的回应方式。但我从球迷那里感受到的是，他们入场观赛后确实有些沮丧。

utterances.source_text: Number one, it's going to be...
utterances.translated_text: 首先，这将会...

utterances.source_text: could you explain to us why you are so closed off when it comes to doing this?
utterances.translated_text: 能否解释为何你对此事如此讳莫如深？

utterances.source_text: I don't see that in the supporters at all. And I know that in you. So you don't have that feeling. I mean, it's certainly the political school. But I think they're all supporting such a high level. Because Francisco Farnsworth, the majority of it, they are so happy to see the team and they're less surprised. Because no manager would think if you give me a push come from one side, give the other one up. And we talk about different teams.
utterances.translated_text: 我完全没从球迷身上感受到这种情绪。我了解你的立场，所以你没有这种感受。这当然是政治话术。但我觉得所有球迷都给予了极高支持。因为弗朗西斯科·法恩斯沃思——他们中的大多数人——看到球队时都很快乐，甚至不太惊讶。毕竟没有教练会认为：若你从一侧施压，我就放弃另一侧。我们讨论的是不同的球队。

utterances.source_text: anything is okay.
utterances.translated_text: 怎样都行。

utterances.source_text: Have a good one.
utterances.translated_text: 祝顺利。

utterances.source_text: The car's issue, is that one he picked up in the car, was that famous, he'd carried that before that? Oh, it was, it was over there, I was carrying it.
utterances.translated_text: 车辆问题——是他在车里发现的那个吗？那个很有名吧？他之前就带着它吗？哦，是在那边，当时是我拿着的。

utterances.source_text: and what is angel?
utterances.translated_text: 天使是什么？

utterances.source_text: Okay. What is this engine? It wasn't a totalization.
utterances.translated_text: 好的。这个引擎是什么？不是整体化设计。

utterances.source_text: And I think it's a great way to help to do that for the onus.
utterances.translated_text: 我认为这是帮助承担责任的好方法。

utterances.source_text: Is there been any setback with that? No, there is progression but hopefully there will be a matter of days and weeks but we'll have to see when there's more than one heavy risk with that end of the day.
utterances.translated_text: 这方面有遇到挫折吗？没有，正在逐步推进，希望几周内能有进展。但最终若存在多重高风险，我们还需观察。

utterances.source_text: And the way at the start of the season when you need players to sort of make themselves available and play through the pain even if that means taking risks.
utterances.translated_text: 赛季初需要球员保持可用状态，即使忍痛作战甚至承担风险。

utterances.source_text: We are trying to do that and we know how important availability is in this crucial period of the season. We will be missing 45 starts as much as weeks, which has an impact.
utterances.translated_text: 我们正努力实现这一目标，深知赛季关键时期球员可用的重要性。我们将缺席长达45周的比赛，这会产生影响。

utterances.source_text: So that would be...
utterances.translated_text: 所以那将是...

utterances.source_text: This is...
utterances.translated_text: 这是...

Now you've had some time to look back at that game and obviously you want to see a response going forward. How much of what you think the recent struggles have been are down to tactical approach versus player performance and execution?
utterances.translated_text: 你提到在高压下获得的机会，以及球如何失控、进攻如何受阻。现在你有时间回顾那场比赛，显然希望看到未来的回应。你认为近期的困境有多少是战术安排问题，又有多少是球员表现和执行问题？

utterances.source_text: I don't know if you understand the question. It's good. I think there is always a balance between the two. There is no play without a situation. It is about the decision that is made on the moment and how it goes.
utterances.translated_text: 我不确定你是否理解这个问题。很好。我认为两者之间总需要平衡。没有情境就没有比赛，关键在于瞬间的决策及其发展。

utterances.source_text: that execution has a relation to the decision of the US.
utterances.translated_text: 这种执行与美国的决策有关。

utterances.source_text: especially when you are attacking the Israeli-Indian summit.
utterances.translated_text: 尤其是在攻击以色列-印度峰会时。

utterances.source_text: And you've mentioned that you're feeling sort of fine and obviously your intentions going into...
utterances.translated_text: 你提到感觉还不错，显然你的意图是...
